title: task.steer input
description: Redirect a delegated worker, or raise one declared lane-budget dimension. A raise changes its cap without steering. The caller must be its parent or ancestor, escalation target, or an active delegated sibling with the same parent and project.

limits.description: Typed raise of one declared lane-budget dimension. Names the dimension and the new absolute cap. A value equal to the current cap is refused as the exact limit.
